name: Future Miraidon ex Starter Deck & Build Set

releases.name: Future Miraidon ex Starter Deck & Build Set

description.text: Starter Deck & Build Set Future Miraidon ex, released on 26 January 2024 with the Wild Force and Cyber Judge expansions and with Ancient Koraidon ex's: a ready-built 60-card deck around a new Miraidon ex, a Future Pokémon of the Dragon type with two attacks, one stronger when the opponent's Active Pokémon is already damaged, with Future Pokémon such as Iron Hands, Iron Valiant and Iron Jugulis. Each box held 228 cards of 61 kinds: the deck and 168 extra cards for improving it, the same in both boxes, 112 of them basic Energy (14 of each type). Strong cards such as the ACE SPEC Master Ball, Radiant Greninja, Pidgeot ex, Iono and Counter Catcher are among them. A card box, a coin, a playmat, damage counters and markers, a VSTAR marker and guides to the deck and the extra cards came with it. The two boxes' cards carry their own expansion marks. This set holds the 53 kinds besides basic Energy.
